paper.title: Hallucinations in LLMs: A Lifecycle-Based Survey of Causes, Detection, Mitigation, and Prevention
paper.abstract: The lifecycle of hallucination in LLMs is a concept that enables building solid frameworks on the control and reliability of LLMs in high-stakes environments, including health, legal, and scientific research. Although previous surveys have primarily focused on detection or mitigation, this survey provides a lifecycle-based overview of the hallucinations in the LLMs, their cause, detection, mitigation, and this http URL propose a three-fold categorization of hallucinations across the LLM lifecycl

summary.core_problem: 梳理 LLM 幻觉在数据、训练、推理三个生命周期阶段中的成因、检测、缓解与预防方法。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是综述与分类框架。它把幻觉问题从单点检测或缓解，扩展到模型开发流程中的多阶段风险管理，对可靠性、安全和高风险场景部署有参考意义；但从摘要看，主要是整理已有工作，不是新的训练方法或机制实验证据。
summary.technical_approach: 提出三段式生命周期分类：data-related、training-related、inference-related hallucinations。每一类分别讨论成因、检测方法、缓解或预防手段，并对已有 benchmark 数据按若干参数比较其适用性。
summary.experiments: 综述论文，无模型训练实验。主要实验性内容是对已有 hallucination benchmark 的维度化比较；摘要未给出新的大规模评测结果或定量结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper surveys hallucinations in LLMs through a lifecycle lens, covering causes, detection, mitigation, and prevention across data, training, and inference stages.
summary_en.importance: This is a survey and taxonomy contribution. It reframes hallucination control as a lifecycle problem rather than only a detection or decoding issue, which is useful for reliability work in high-stakes settings. It does not appear to introduce a new training method or a new mechanistic experiment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The survey organizes hallucinations into data-related, training-related, and inference-related categories. For each stage, it reviews causes, detection methods, and mitigation or prevention interventions, and compares existing benchmarks along multiple suitability dimensions.
summary_en.experiments: There are no new model-training experiments. The empirical component appears to be a structured comparison of existing hallucination benchmarks, with no new large-scale quantitative results reported in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 作为幻觉治理 checklist 可备查；预训练研究员只需看 data/training 归因表，别期待新机制证据。
recommendation.en: Useful as a hallucination-control checklist; pretraining readers can skim the data/training-cause tables and should not expect new mechanistic evidence.

paper.title: Exploring the Role of LLMs in HPC Programming: A Survey
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are emerging as promising assistants in High-Performance Computing (HPC), where programming remains complex and expertise-intensive. This survey systematically reviews their application across five categories: code generation, parallelization and optimization, frameworks and architectures, evaluation and benchmarking, and broader challenges. The analysis highlights both opportunities and limitations: while general-purpose LLMs perform reasonably well on serial and Op

summary.core_problem: 系统梳理 LLM 在高性能计算编程中的用途、能力边界和评测问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是领域性 survey。它与代码模型、代码 agent 和专业化数据有关，但 HPC 是较窄场景，对通用基座预训练的直接信息有限。可作为代码模型在并行编程上短板的资料入口。
summary.technical_approach: 综述按五类组织：代码生成、并行化与优化、框架与架构、评测与 benchmark、挑战。讨论通用 LLM 在串行代码、OpenMP、MPI 等不同并行范式上的表现，也覆盖 HPC-Coder、HPC-GPT、chatHPC 等专用模型及微调、 curated dataset、RAG 的作用。
summary.experiments: 作为 survey，本身不报告统一新实验。摘要给出的归纳是：通用 LLM 在串行和 OpenMP 类任务上表现尚可，但在 MPI 等分布式范式中正确性和可扩展性不足；专用模型通过微调、 curated datasets 和 RAG 获得更高准确率，但覆盖范围窄，评估多限于 benchmark 或 micro-kernel。

summary_en.core_problem: The survey reviews how LLMs are used in high-performance-computing programming and where they fail.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a domain-specific survey. It touches code models, coding agents, and specialized data, but HPC is a narrow setting and provides limited direct signal for general base-model pretraining. It is useful as an entry point on code-model weaknesses in parallel programming.
summary_en.technical_approach: The review is organized into five categories: code generation, parallelization and optimization, frameworks and architectures, evaluation and benchmarking, and broader challenges. It contrasts general-purpose LLMs on serial, OpenMP-like, and MPI-style tasks, and discusses specialized systems such as HPC-Coder, HPC-GPT, and chatHPC using fine-tuning, curated datasets, or RAG.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, it does not introduce a new unified experiment. The abstract summarizes that general LLMs are reasonable on serial and OpenMP-like tasks but weak on distributed paradigms such as MPI, where correctness and scalability are critical. Specialized models improve accuracy but remain narrow and are mostly evaluated on benchmarks or micro-kernels.

recommendation.zh: 作为代码模型在 MPI/并行优化上失效模式的索引即可；survey 本身不提供新的训练结论。
recommendation.en: Use it as an index of code-model failure modes in MPI and parallel optimization; the survey itself offers no new training result.

paper.title: Unsupervised Post-Training of Foundation Models: A Survey
paper.abstract: Foundation-model post-training usually relies on human labels, preference data, stronger teachers, or executable verifiers. We study Unsupervised Post-Training (UPT): update-bearing adaptation on unlabeled inputs whose learning signal is derived from same-lineage model artifacts rather than an external oracle. We catalog 80 strict UPT methods and organize them by the object that supplies the update signal: a prediction statistic, a sample relation, a self-generated target, or an internal evaluat

summary.core_problem: 梳理不依赖人工标签、偏好数据、强教师或外部 verifier 的无监督后训练方法，并分析这些内部信号何时有效、何时会放大错误。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是综述和框架整理。它对 pretrain 研究的价值在于补全 pretrain 到 posttrain 的接口：模型自身统计量、样本关系、自生成目标和内部评估器能否提供稳定训练信号。
summary.technical_approach: 论文定义 Unsupervised Post-Training 为在无标签输入上进行参数更新，学习信号来自同源模型产物而非外部 oracle。作者整理 80 个严格符合定义的方法，并按更新信号来源分类：prediction statistic、sample relation、self-generated target、internal evaluator。另提出 Input Visibility × Update Persistence 的二维视角，用于映射部署场景和选择 UPT 方法。
summary.experiments: 这是 survey，摘要未显示统一复现实验或新模型训练结果。主要产出是方法 taxonomy、失败模式分析和评估选择框架，重点讨论内部信号与任务结构如何决定收益或递归错误放大。

summary_en.core_problem: The survey organizes unsupervised post-training methods that adapt foundation models on unlabeled inputs without human labels, preference data, stronger teachers, or external verifiers.
summary_en.importance: This is a taxonomy and framework contribution. For pretraining researchers, its value is in clarifying the interface between base models and update-bearing adaptation when the training signal comes from the model’s own artifacts.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper defines Unsupervised Post-Training as parameter-updating adaptation on unlabeled inputs where the learning signal is derived from same-lineage model artifacts rather than an external oracle. It catalogs 80 strict UPT methods and groups them by signal source: prediction statistics, sample relations, self-generated targets, and internal evaluators. It also introduces an Input Visibility by Update Persistence view for deployment regimes and method selection.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, the abstract does not report a unified reproduction or new model-training experiment. The contribution is a taxonomy, an analysis of when internal signals help or amplify errors, and a framework for UPT selection and evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 综述可作索引；真正要看的是内部信号分类和错误递归条件，不必逐篇跟 80 个方法。
recommendation.en: Use it as an index; the useful part is the signal taxonomy and failure conditions, not the full list of 80 methods.

paper.title: Retrieved But Not Reliable: A Survey on Attacks, and Defenses in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances large language models by grounding outputs in external knowledge, improving factuality and reducing hallucinations. At the same time, the retrieval-augmented pipeline introduces new robustness and security risks, including corpus poisoning, backdoor attacks, privacy leakage, and fairness violations. Despite rapid progress in this area, existing surveys remain limited in their treatment of attacker objectives, threat models, and stage-specific defense

summary.core_problem: 系统性地综述检索增强生成（RAG）系统中存在的攻击方法和防御策略。
summary.importance: RAG 虽然减少了幻觉，但也引入了新的安全和鲁棒性风险。本文提供了一个统一的、基于 pipeline 的视角来审视 RAG 的鲁棒性，填补了现有综述在攻击目标、威胁模型和阶段性防御方面的不全面。
summary.technical_approach: 形式化了针对语料库、检索器和生成器的威胁模型，将攻击目标分为准确性、隐私和公平性三类。从 pipeline 视角（检索、重排、生成、回溯）回顾了防御方法，并总结了鲁棒性基准和可解释性方法。
summary.experiments: 本文为综述文章，无具体实验。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自越南国立大学、弗吉尼亚理工大学、印第安纳大学等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: Systematically surveying attack methods and defense strategies in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.
summary_en.importance: While RAG reduces hallucinations, it introduces new security and robustness risks. This paper provides a unified, pipeline-aware perspective on RAG robustness, filling gaps in existing surveys regarding attacker objectives, threat models, and stage-specific defenses.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formalizes threat models over the corpus, retriever, and generator, categorizing attack objectives into accuracy, privacy, and fairness. Reviews defenses from a pipeline perspective (retrieval, rerank, generation, traceback) and summarizes robustness benchmarks and explainability methods.
summary_en.experiments: This is a survey paper; no specific experiments were conducted.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Vietnam National University, Virginia Tech, Indiana University, etc.

recommendation.zh: 关于 RAG 安全性和鲁棒性的全面综述，适合作为 RAG 系统设计的安全参考，预训练研究员可快速浏览以了解潜在的 data poisoning 风险。
recommendation.en: A comprehensive survey on RAG security and robustness, suitable as a security reference for RAG system design. Pretrain researchers can glance at it to understand potential data poisoning risks.

paper.title: Representation Learning in Diffusion and Flow-based Model: An Application Aspect
paper.abstract: Diffusion models and flow-based models have recently become the dominant paradigms in generative modeling, largely due to their ability to learn rich, multi-level visual representations through large-scale training. This creates a bidirectional relationship between generative models and representation learning: improving representation learning enhances generation quality, while the learned representations can be leveraged for broader understanding tasks. This survey systematically explores this

summary.core_problem: 扩散模型和基于流的模型在表示学习和生成任务中的相互作用及应用现状如何？
summary.importance: 提供了一份系统性的综述，探讨了生成模型与表示学习之间的双向关系，并提出了一个三层渐进式框架来组织现有工作。
summary.technical_approach: 从三个角度分类现有工作：利用表示学习提升生成能力、利用生成模型提取表示用于感知任务、以及迈向通用统一应用。系统分类了在图像分类、密集视觉预测等下游任务中的代表性方法。
summary.experiments: 无具体实验，为综述文章。
summary.authors_note: 北京邮电大学团队。

summary_en.core_problem: What is the current state of interplay and applications between representation learning and generative tasks in diffusion and flow-based models?
summary_en.importance: Provides a systematic survey exploring the bidirectional relationship between generative models and representation learning, proposing a three-tier progressive framework to organize existing works.
summary_en.technical_approach: Categorizes existing works from three perspectives: using representation learning to improve generation, exploiting generative models for representation extraction in perception tasks, and moving towards general-purpose unified applications. Systematically categorizes representative methods across downstream tasks like image classification and dense visual prediction.
summary_en.experiments: No specific experiments; this is a survey paper.
summary_en.authors_note: Team from Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications.

recommendation.zh: 关于扩散模型和流模型中表示学习的综述，主要侧重视觉领域，作为文献备查即可。
recommendation.en: A survey on representation learning in diffusion and flow models, primarily focusing on the visual domain; useful as a literature reference.

paper.title: A Survey on Foundations and Frontiers of Multimodal Agentic Frameworks: Techniques and Applications
paper.abstract: Advances in large language models (LLMs) have fueled a wave of research into agency: the ability to reason, plan, and act. This effort has produced agentic frameworks that orchestrate perception, memory, and decision-making around powerful LLM backbones. With the advent of large multimodal models (LMMs), these systems can process and integrate diverse modalities, including images, audio, and video, thereby improving their real-world applicability. Yet, while surveys of LLM-based agents exist, th

summary.core_problem: 系统整理多模态大模型进入 agent 框架后，感知、推理、规划、记忆和行动模块如何被不同模态改变。
summary.importance: 贡献是综述和分类框架，不是新模型或新训练方法；对理解 multimodal agent 的工程分解、模态融合方式和应用边界有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 以 agent 功能模块为组织线索，梳理从文本中心 agent 到多模态 agent 的演进；比较 delegated、late-fusion 和 early-fusion 等模态集成架构，并讨论多模态感知如何进入记忆、规划和行动环节。
summary.experiments: 作为 survey，摘要没有报告统一实验；主要贡献应是文献整理、方法分类和应用图谱，而不是模型参数规模或 benchmark 结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Maryland, IISc Bangalore, KAUST, Johns Hopkins University, University of Oxford、UNIST 等机构；Philip Torr、Mike Zheng Shou、Mohamed Elhoseiny 等为视觉和多模态领域知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The survey organizes how multimodal large models reshape the perception, reasoning, planning, memory, and action modules of agentic frameworks.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a taxonomy and literature synthesis rather than a new model or training method; it is useful for understanding the engineering decomposition, fusion choices, and application boundaries of multimodal agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: It uses agent functional modules as the organizing lens, traces the shift from text-centric agents to multimodal systems, compares delegated, late-fusion, and early-fusion integration patterns, and discusses how multimodal perception feeds memory, planning, and action.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, the abstract does not report unified experiments; the expected contribution is literature organization, method taxonomy, and application mapping rather than model scale or benchmark scores.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of Maryland, IISc Bangalore, KAUST, Johns Hopkins University, the University of Oxford, UNIST, and others. Philip Torr, Mike Zheng Shou, and Mohamed Elhoseiny are well-known researchers in vision and multimodal learning.

recommendation.zh: 适合补多模态 agent 版图，不是 pretrain 方法来源；只看 taxonomy 和融合架构表即可。
recommendation.en: Useful for mapping multimodal-agent terminology, not a pretraining-method source; read the taxonomy and fusion-architecture tables.

paper.title: Vision-Language Models for Egocentric Video: From Hand-Object Interaction to Embodied AI
paper.abstract: Egocentric video captures activities from the wearer's perspective, providing a direct view of human attention, hand--object interaction, and goal-directed behavior. This perspective is increasingly important for wearable intelligence, assistive systems, human--robot interaction, and embodied AI, yet it introduces challenges including ego-motion, occlusion, small active objects, viewpoint-dependent appearance, and long-range temporal dependencies. Vision--language models (VLMs) offer a promising

summary.core_problem: 梳理第一视角视频中的视觉语言模型研究，重点覆盖手-物交互、长时序理解、具身智能和可穿戴场景。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是综述。它把 egocentric video 从传统识别模型整理到多模态基础模型和具身系统，对理解 VLM 在真实交互数据上的限制有参考价值，但不是新的预训练方法或数据配比工作。
summary.technical_approach: 论文按任务、数据集、手-物交互、时间推理、帧/片段选择、多模态表示等主题组织已有工作，讨论 ego-motion、遮挡、小目标、视角依赖外观和长程依赖带来的建模难点。
summary.experiments: 作为综述，摘要未显示新的模型训练或统一实验；主要价值在文献分类、任务脉络和问题归纳，而不是可复现实验结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Tehran。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper surveys vision-language models for egocentric video, with emphasis on hand-object interaction, long-range temporal understanding, and embodied AI.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a survey. It organizes the transition from conventional recognition pipelines to multimodal foundation models for egocentric video, which is useful context for VLM researchers but not a new pretraining recipe or modeling objective.
summary_en.technical_approach: The survey structures prior work around tasks, datasets, hand-object interaction, temporal reasoning, frame and clip selection, and multimodal representation, while highlighting ego-motion, occlusion, small active objects, viewpoint-specific appearance, and long temporal dependencies.
summary_en.experiments: No new training run or controlled benchmark is indicated in the abstract; the value is in taxonomy and problem framing rather than empirical model results.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Tehran.

recommendation.zh: 作为 egocentric VLM 文献地图可留档；预训练研究员扫任务和数据集部分即可，不必细读方法表。
recommendation.en: Useful as a map of egocentric VLM tasks and datasets; for pretraining work, skim the taxonomy rather than the full survey.

paper.title: Self-Evolving Agents as Dynamic Graph Transformation: A Survey and New Perspective
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly becoming self-evolving systems that persist across interactions, maintain memories, use tools, acquire skills, refine workflows, and coordinate with other agents. These capabilities make agent states structural and dynamic: entities, relations, attributes, dependencies, and execution structures change with new evidence, feedback, and environmental conditions. Existing graph-agent surveys typically treat graphs as support structures for age

summary.core_problem: 综述 self-evolving LLM agents，并提出把 agent 的记忆、工具、技能、工作流和多 agent 关系统一表示为动态图变换。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是综述和视角重组，不是新训练方法。它对长期 agent 状态管理、记忆结构和工作流演化有一定整理价值，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者将 agent state 抽象为动态图：节点表示记忆、工具、技能、任务、工作流或其他 agent，边表示依赖、调用、证据和协作关系；agent 的自我演化被描述为图结构、属性和拓扑随反馈与环境变化而更新。
summary.experiments: 综述论文，没有模型训练实验或统一 benchmark 结果。主要产出是分类框架、概念模型和未来研究方向。
summary.authors_note: 作者机构信息包括 University of New South Wales、University of Technology Sydney、University of Hong Kong-Shenzhen、Zhejiang Gongshang University。

summary_en.core_problem: The survey reviews self-evolving LLM agents and proposes representing their memories, tools, skills, workflows, and inter-agent relations as dynamic graph transformations.
summary_en.importance: This is a survey and reframing contribution rather than a new modeling method. It is useful for thinking about long-lived agent state, memory structure, and workflow evolution, but it is distant from foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors abstract agent state as a dynamic graph: nodes represent memories, tools, skills, tasks, workflows, or other agents, while edges encode dependencies, calls, evidence, and collaboration. Agent evolution is framed as changes in graph topology and attributes under feedback and environment shifts.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, it does not report model-training experiments or unified benchmark numbers. The main outputs are a taxonomy, conceptual model, and research agenda.
summary_en.authors_note: Listed affiliations include University of New South Wales, University of Technology Sydney, University of Hong Kong-Shenzhen, and Zhejiang Gongshang University.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent memory/workflow 文献索引用；动态图表述自然但偏 taxonomy，预训练侧没有直接动作。
recommendation.en: Use it as an index for agent memory and workflow papers; the dynamic-graph framing is natural but mostly taxonomic.

paper.title: Not All Attention Is Equal: A Quantitative Survey of the EEI Trade-off
paper.abstract: Attention mechanisms have driven machine learning for a decade, from neural machine translation to language models that do general-purpose reasoning. This survey covers four connected threads: their formulation for sequence-to-sequence tasks, adaptation to computer vision, efficiency innovations that address the quadratic bottleneck, and advances in interpretability. We define three criteria: efficiency, expressiveness, and interpretability, and compare twenty-one methods using an EEI scoring fr

summary.core_problem: 注意力机制十年来衍生大量变体，缺乏在效率（efficiency）、表达力（expressiveness）、可解释性（interpretability）三维度下的系统比较，且细粒度排名是否可靠存疑。
summary.importance: 综述贡献：梳理从 Bahdanau/Luong 到 Transformer 及高效注意力的发展脉络，提出 EEI 三维评分框架比较 21 种方法；核心发现是排名在扰动下高度不稳定，只适合粗粒度分层比较。
summary.technical_approach: 单评分者对 21 种注意力方法按 EEI 三维打分（假设 ±1 分扰动），用 200,000 次确定性 Monte Carlo 分析排名稳定性，并与 rank-matched null model 对照。
summary.experiments: 67-70% 的样本中排名变化超过一位；null model 重现类似稳定性，表明细粒度排名不可靠，应仅做 tier-level 比较。

summary_en.core_problem: A decade of attention variants has produced no systematic comparison along efficiency, expressiveness, and interpretability, and the reliability of fine-grained rankings is questionable.
summary_en.importance: Survey contribution: traces attention from Bahdanau-Luong alignment through Transformers and efficient variants, proposing an EEI scoring framework across 21 methods; the key finding is that rankings are highly unstable under perturbation, supporting only coarse tier-level comparisons.
summary_en.technical_approach: A single rater scores 21 attention methods on EEI dimensions (assuming ±1-point perturbation), with 200,000-sample deterministic Monte Carlo analysis of rank stability, compared against a rank-matched null model.
summary_en.experiments: Rank changes of more than one position occur in 67-70% of samples; the null model reproduces a similar stability profile, indicating fine-grained rankings are unreliable.

recommendation.zh: 单评分者综述，结论（注意力排名不稳定）不算意外；作为注意力变体的文献地图备查即可，不值得通读。
recommendation.en: Single-rater survey whose conclusion (attention rankings are unstable) is unsurprising; keep as a literature map of attention variants but not worth a full read.

paper.title: Beyond Tokens: A Survey on Decoding Methods for Large Language and Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) and large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated impressive generative capabilities, yet ensuring their outputs align with user intent is still challenging. While most existing approaches address this issue at the training stage, inference-time approaches like decoding methods offer a more efficient and scalable solution. Decoding methods control model generation by guiding token-level selection, performing sequence-level generation, or generating tokens in

summary.core_problem: 系统梳理LLM与VLM的解码（inference-time）方法：如何在不改训练的情况下控制生成质量/对齐与效率。
summary.importance: 综述型工作：对推理侧控制与加速的版图做归纳，适合作为文献入口；但不提供新的算法或可验证的新结论。
summary.technical_approach: 将解码方法归纳为三类范式：token级选择引导（如采样/约束/对比等）、序列级生成（如重排序/搜索）、并行生成以加速（如speculative/并行解码等）；并讨论挑战与未来方向。
summary.experiments: 综述论文通常无统一实验；摘要未给出新的实证结果。附资源链接（GitHub）便于查表式检索。
summary.authors_note: Emory University；Illinois Institute of Technology；University of Illinois Chicago

summary_en.core_problem: Survey decoding (inference-time) methods for LLMs and VLMs to control generation quality/alignment and improve efficiency without retraining.
summary_en.importance: A literature entry point mapping the decoding landscape; useful for orientation, but it does not introduce new algorithms or new empirical claims.
summary_en.technical_approach: Organizes decoding into three paradigms: token-level guidance, sequence-level generation (search/reranking), and parallel generation for acceleration (e.g., speculative/parallel decoding), plus open challenges and directions.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, it does not present a unified new experimental result in the abstract; includes a resource list/GitHub for lookup.
summary_en.authors_note: Emory University; Illinois Institute of Technology; University of Illinois Chicago.

recommendation.zh: 当目录用还行：只需扫它的分类框架和资源链接，别指望有新结论；真正要学方法还是回原论文看细节。
recommendation.en: Fine as a table-of-contents: skim the taxonomy and resource links, but don’t expect new results—read the original papers for details.

paper.title: Position Encoding in Transformers: From Absolute and Relative Methods to Rotary Position Embeddings and Long-Context Scaling
paper.abstract: Self-attention models content-dependent interactions between tokens but does not by itself encode token order. Position encoding addresses this limitation by introducing absolute coordinates, relative distances, or position-dependent rotations into Transformer representations and attention scores. This technical survey develops a unified account of sinusoidal and learned absolute position embeddings, Shaw-style relative position representations, Transformer-XL, T5 relative position bias, ALiBi,

summary.core_problem: 系统梳理 Transformer 中位置编码的设计空间，并解释 RoPE 及其长上下文扩展为何有效、代价在哪里。
summary.importance: 这是一篇技术综述，不是新方法论文。价值在于把绝对位置、相对位置、RoPE、ALiBi 以及 Position Interpolation、NTK-aware scaling、YaRN、LongRoPE 等长上下文方案放到同一框架下比较，适合作为预训练和长上下文建模的知识整理材料。
summary.technical_approach: 文章从位置注入位置、对 attention score 的作用方式、与 KV-cache 的兼容性、长度外推能力等维度统一分析多类位置编码；重点推导 RoPE 如何把绝对位置索引转成 Query-Key 内积中的相对相位差，并讨论多种 RoPE scaling/插值方法的频率分配与上下文扩展机制。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，核心是理论推导与方法比较，不像包含新的大规模训练实验。更像对已有方法的归纳、公式化解释和工程属性对比，适合查阅概念差异，不适合把其中结论当作新的实证证据。

summary_en.core_problem: It organizes the design space of positional encoding in Transformers and explains why RoPE and its long-context extensions work, along with their trade-offs.
summary_en.importance: This is a technical survey rather than a new method paper. Its value is in placing absolute, relative, RoPE, ALiBi, and long-context extensions such as Position Interpolation, NTK-aware scaling, YaRN, and LongRoPE under one comparative framework, which is useful background for pretraining and long-context modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper unifies positional methods by where position is injected, how it affects attention scores, KV-cache compatibility, and length extrapolation. It emphasizes a derivation of how RoPE turns absolute indices into relative phase differences in QK inner products, then discusses scaling/interpolation variants through frequency allocation and context extension behavior.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, this appears to be primarily theoretical and comparative rather than a source of new large-scale training evidence. It is better treated as a reference for conceptual distinctions and engineering trade-offs than as fresh empirical proof.

recommendation.zh: 综述写得再全也只是综述；如果你在做长上下文或改 RoPE，拿它当索引表即可，不必通读正文。
recommendation.en: A useful index if you work on long context or RoPE variants, but it is still a survey; use it as a map, not as evidence.

paper.title: Multi-Agent Debate Strategies: Survey, Taxonomy, and Challenges
paper.abstract: Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) is a promising paradigm for improving the accuracy and robustness of Large Language Model (LLM)-based agentic systems. It enables multiple agents to exchange arguments, critique each other's outputs, and iteratively converge towards a solution. However, research remains fragmented, with inconsistent terminology and no rigorous synthesis of MAD design dimensions. We present a systematic literature review characterizing 141 primary studies on MAD. We derive a three-dimensi

summary.core_problem: 这篇综述试图整理 Multi-Agent Debate 研究中混乱的术语和设计空间，给出一个能描述不同辩论式 Agent 系统的分类框架。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，但对推理时计算、Agent 评测和合成数据流程有参考价值。多 Agent 辩论常被用来提升推理可靠性，但很多工作没有分清参与者设计、交互机制和最终裁决协议。这个综述的用处在于帮助读者判断某个 MAD 系统到底改了哪里，避免把普通多采样、角色扮演、投票和真正的交互式批判混在一起。
summary.technical_approach: 作者按照系统综述流程整理 141 篇 MAD 相关研究，并把设计空间压到三个维度：participants，即参与者如何设定，包括角色、能力、是否同构、是否有 judge 或 summarizer；interaction mechanisms，即智能体之间如何交换信息、质疑、响应和更新；agreement protocols，即如何达成最终输出，例如投票、仲裁、共识、裁判模型或固定轮数后选择。文中还引入形式化记号来描述 MAD 配置，目标是让不同系统可以在同一套语言下比较。它不是提出新的 Agent 架构，而是做概念清理和设计维度归纳。
summary.experiments: 这是综述型工作，没有模型训练实验。主要结果来自对 141 篇 primary studies 的编码和统计。摘要和引言给出的核心发现是：MAD 研究已经在实践中收敛到较窄的一类设计模式，但术语并不统一，很多论文只在角色数量、轮数、裁决方式上做局部变化。作者围绕应用领域、参与者设计、交互结构和协议四个研究问题组织分析。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 taxonomy 表、形式化记号说明，以及关于 participants、interaction、agreement 三个维度的章节。若只关心通用 Agent 或推理时计算，可以跳过应用领域枚举，重点看不同裁决协议如何影响成本、稳定性和错误传播。若要做多 Agent 评测或构造辩论数据，可进一步看作者对常见设计模式和开放挑战的整理。

summary_en.core_problem: This survey addresses the lack of consistent terminology and design structure in Multi-Agent Debate. Its goal is to provide a taxonomy for describing how debate-based LLM agent systems are built and resolved.
summary_en.importance: The direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining is limited, but it is useful for inference-time reasoning, agent evaluation, and debate-style data generation. Multi-agent debate is often claimed to improve robustness, yet many systems differ only in sampling, role prompts, communication topology, or voting rules. The taxonomy helps separate these factors and makes it easier to judge what a MAD system actually changes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors conduct a systematic literature review over 141 primary studies. They organize the design space along three axes. The first is participants: role assignment, agent specialization, homogeneous versus heterogeneous agents, and auxiliary roles such as judges or summarizers. The second is interaction mechanisms: how agents exchange arguments, critique each other, respond, and update intermediate answers. The third is agreement protocols: how the system selects a final answer, through voting, consensus, arbitration, judge models, or fixed-round resolution. The paper also introduces formal notations for representing MAD configurations. Its contribution is taxonomy and synthesis rather than a new agent method.
summary_en.experiments: There are no model training experiments. The evidence comes from coding and analyzing 141 primary studies. The main reported finding is that the field has converged in practice on a relatively narrow family of designs, while terminology remains inconsistent. The review structures its analysis around application domains, participant design, interaction structure, and agreement mechanisms.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the taxonomy tables, the formal notation, and the sections on participants, interaction mechanisms, and agreement protocols. Readers interested in general agent research or inference-time compute can skip most of the application-domain enumeration and look instead at how resolution protocols affect cost, stability, and error propagation. For debate-data construction or agent benchmarks, the sections on recurring patterns and open challenges are the most useful.

recommendation.zh: 一篇详实的 Multi-Agent Debate 综述，指出了当前研究在拓扑结构和交互机制上的同质化问题，对设计多智能体协作框架的研究员有参考价值，建议快速浏览其 Taxonomy。
recommendation.en: A detailed survey on Multi-Agent Debate, pointing out the homogenization in topologies and interaction mechanisms in current research. Valuable for researchers designing multi-agent collaboration frameworks; recommend skimming its taxonomy.

paper.title: Post-Training in Time Series Foundation Models: A Unifying Framework
paper.abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) have emerged as general-purpose models for time series analysis, but pretraining alone is often insufficient for reliable downstream deployment. Bridging this gap requires further intervention to handle domain shift, task heterogeneity, limited supervision, and computational constraints, which motivates post-training as a broad class of methods to adapt, augment, compose, calibrate, or specialize pretrained TSFMs for downstream tasks. In this work, we analyz

summary.core_problem: 时间序列基础模型仅靠预训练无法应对下游域偏移、任务异构等问题，缺乏统一的后训练方法分析框架。
summary.importance: 框架创新与综述贡献，首次按干预位置将时间序列基础模型后训练分为五大类，给出系统分析视角与未来方向。
summary.technical_approach: 按照预测流水线中的干预位置，将后训练方法分为参数适配、上下文增强、模型组合、输出处理与不确定性控制、压缩与专业化五大类，梳理各类方法的代表工作与局限。
summary.experiments: 无原创实验，为综述性框架研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Time series foundation models cannot handle downstream domain shift and task heterogeneity with pretraining alone, and lack a unified analytical framework for post-training methods.
summary_en.importance: Framework innovation and survey contribution, first categorizing time series foundation model post-training into five categories by intervention location, providing a systematic analysis perspective and future directions.
summary_en.technical_approach: Categorizes post-training methods into five categories based on their intervention locus in the prediction pipeline: parameter adaptation, context augmentation, model composition, output processing and uncertainty control, and compression and specialization, sorting out representative works and limitations of each category.
summary_en.experiments: No original experiments; it is a survey-style framework study.

recommendation.zh: 时间序列基础模型后训练的统一分类框架，可参考其干预维度的划分思路，无需深读正文。
recommendation.en: Unified post-training taxonomy for time series foundation models; reference the intervention dimension categorization, no deep reading needed.

paper.title: Engineering Trustworthy Agentic AI for Critical Systems
paper.abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence systems, capable of autonomous perception, planning, tool use, and multi-step action, are increasingly proposed for critical engineering domains where decisions carry physical, operational, or economic consequences. This survey addresses a gap in current literature by treating trustworthiness, whether agentic behavior can be verified, audited, and trusted under the constraints that engineering practice actually requires, as a first-class engineering property, rath

summary.core_problem: 系统梳理 critical engineering systems 中 agentic AI 的可信性要求，包括安全、鲁棒、透明、可追责和隐私安全。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是综述和工程框架，不是新算法或评测资产。它对通用 Agent 安全治理有参考价值，但对预训练方法、数据或训练目标没有直接推进。
summary.technical_approach: 论文将 trustworthy agentic AI 拆成五个横向维度：safety and constraint satisfaction、robustness and reliability、transparency and interpretability、accountability and auditability、privacy and security，并映射到从感知到审计的 assurance workflow。
summary.experiments: 作为 survey，摘要未描述实验、模型规模或定量评测；重点是架构、威胁、trust mechanisms 和可量化保证方法的整理。

summary_en.core_problem: The survey organizes trustworthiness requirements for agentic AI in critical engineering systems, covering safety, robustness, transparency, accountability, and privacy/security.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a survey and engineering framework rather than a new algorithm or benchmark. It may be useful for agent safety governance, but it does not directly inform pretraining data, objectives, or training dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper defines a five-dimensional trustworthiness model: safety and constraint satisfaction, robustness and reliability, transparency and interpretability, accountability and auditability, and privacy and security. These dimensions are mapped onto an assurance workflow from perception to audit.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, the abstract does not report experiments, model sizes, or quantitative evaluations. The emphasis is on architectures, threats, trust mechanisms, and quantitative assurance methods.

recommendation.zh: 适合做 agent 安全 checklist 备查；没有训练信号或架构 insight，预训练研究员看摘要够了。
recommendation.en: Useful as an agent-safety checklist, but it offers no training-signal or architecture insight; a pretraining researcher can stop at the abstract.

paper.title: Self-Improvements in Modern Agentic Systems: A Survey
paper.abstract: Self-improving autonomous agents are moving from research prototypes to deployed systems. The primary goal is controllable evolution, or adaptation, from experience with minimal or even no human input. This survey frames modern self-improving agents as adaptive systems that convert experience into accumulated capability gains. We offer a system-level framework that represents a modern agent as a configuration coupling a foundation model with an operational scaffold of prompts, memory, tools, and

summary.core_problem: 梳理现代 agentic systems 如何从自身经验中产生可控更新，实现 prompts、memory、tools、control logic 或模型参数层面的自我改进。
summary.importance: 贡献是综述和分类框架，不是新方法或新实验。它对理解 agent scaffold 与 foundation model 的接口有帮助，但对基座预训练的直接增益有限。
summary.technical_approach: 把现代 agent 表示为 foundation model 与 prompts、memory、tools、control logic 等 operational scaffold 的组合，并将 self-improvement 形式化为 self-induced update operator；按更新目标和驱动信号组织已有工作。
summary.experiments: 作为 survey，摘要未报告新模型训练、数据集构建或统一 benchmark 结果；附带维护 self-improving agents 相关工作的 GitHub 列表。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Jilin University、KAUST、University of Alberta、The Swiss AI Lab IDSIA/USI/SUPSI 等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The survey reviews how modern agentic systems convert experience into controlled updates to prompts, memory, tools, control logic, or model parameters.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a taxonomy and system-level framing rather than a new method or experiment. It is useful for understanding the interface between foundation models and agent scaffolds, but has limited direct value for base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper models an agent as a configuration coupling a foundation model with an operational scaffold of prompts, memory, tools, and control logic, and formalizes self-improvement as a self-induced update operator. Prior work is organized by update target and learning signal.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, it does not report new model training, datasets, or benchmark results in the abstract. It also maintains a GitHub list of self-improving agent papers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Jilin University, KAUST, University of Alberta, and The Swiss AI Lab IDSIA/USI/SUPSI, among others.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent self-improvement 索引留存即可；没有新实验，读图表比读正文划算。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an index for agent self-improvement; there are no new experiments, so tables and taxonomy are enough.

paper.title: Accelerating Masked Diffusion Large Language Models: A Survey of Efficient Inference Techniques
paper.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer a theoretical advantage in parallel generation over standard autoregressive models. However, parallel generation alone does not guarantee practical speedups. Realizing this efficiency requires specialized inference mechanisms, such as diffusion-aware caching and reuse. Consequently, as inference efficiency becomes a prerequisite for practical deployment, recent research has actively explored acceleration techniques across algorithms, architectures, a

summary.core_problem: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）的并行生成理论优势难转化为实际推理加速，且算法、架构、系统层面的延迟影响因素混杂，现有评测难以严谨对比不同加速技术。
summary.importance: 提出首个dLLM推理延迟统一分解框架，系统梳理跨算法、架构、系统的加速技术，属于分析框架+综述贡献，为dLLM的效率优化与落地提供结构化参考。
summary.technical_approach: 构建统一的延迟分解框架，将端到端推理延迟拆解为算法、架构、系统三个独立维度，沿该分类体系梳理现有dLLM加速技术（如扩散感知缓存、计算复用等），并分析各维度的权衡关系。
summary.experiments: 无原创实验，基于已有研究的延迟拆解与技术分类对比，量化了不同因素对实际部署速度的影响。
summary.authors_note: 延世大学Jaegul Choo团队，团队长期从事扩散模型、生成式AI相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The theoretical parallel generation advantage of diffusion large language models (dLLMs) is hard to translate into practical inference speedup, with latency factors across algorithm, architecture, and system levels conflated, making rigorous comparison of acceleration techniques difficult.
summary_en.importance: Proposes the first unified latency decomposition framework for dLLM inference and systematically categorizes acceleration techniques across algorithms, architectures, and systems. It is an analytical framework + survey contribution providing structured reference for dLLM efficiency optimization and deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds a unified latency decomposition framework that breaks down end-to-end inference latency into three independent dimensions: algorithm, architecture, and system. Based on this framework, it surveys existing dLLM acceleration techniques (e.g., diffusion-aware caching, computation reuse) and analyzes cross-dimensional trade-offs.
summary_en.experiments: No original experiments; conducts latency decomposition and technical categorization based on existing studies, quantifying the impact of different factors on real-world deployment speed.
summary_en.authors_note: Jaegul Choo's group at Yonsei University, which has long worked on diffusion models and generative AI.

recommendation.zh: 做非AR语言建模范式的研究员可重点看其延迟分解框架，快速理清dLLM推理效率的核心瓶颈维度，无需逐篇追踪零散文献。
recommendation.en: Researchers working on non-autoregressive LLM paradigms can focus on its latency decomposition framework to quickly identify core dLLM inference bottlenecks without tracking scattered papers.

paper.title: Towards Efficient Large Language Model Serving: A Survey on System-Aware KV Cache Optimization
paper.abstract: Despite the rapid advancements of large language models (LLMs), LLM serving systems remain memory-intensive and costly. The key-value (KV) cache, which stores KV tensors during autoregressive decoding, is crucial for enabling low-latency, high-throughput LLM inference serving. In this survey, we focus on system-aware KV infrastructure for serving LLMs (abbreviated as sKis). We revisit recent work from a system behavior perspective, organizing existing efforts into three dimensions: execution and

summary.core_problem: 系统梳理 LLM serving 中 KV cache 的优化空间，回答内存成本和吞吐瓶颈该如何从系统视角拆解。
summary.importance: 这是综述而非新方法，但主题很实用：KV cache 已经是大模型部署的主瓶颈之一。对做长上下文、推理成本、甚至训练-推理接口设计的人都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 文章把现有 KV cache 工作按三条轴组织：时间维的执行与调度、空间维的放置与迁移、结构维的表示与保留；同时讨论不同系统行为之间的协同设计关系，以及这些设计与延迟、吞吐、内存占用等目标的映射。
summary.experiments: 作为 survey，没有统一实验。价值主要在分类框架和问题分解，而不是新的 benchmark 数字或方法增益。
summary.authors_note: The University of Melbourne、华中科技大学。作者未见到明确的一线 LLM serving 代表性团队信号。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper systematizes the optimization space of KV cache in LLM serving, focusing on how to decompose memory and throughput bottlenecks from a systems perspective.
summary_en.importance: This is a survey rather than a new method, but the topic is practical: KV cache is now one of the dominant bottlenecks in LLM deployment. It is useful for researchers thinking about long context, inference cost, and train–serve interface design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The survey organizes prior work along three axes: execution and scheduling in time, placement and migration in space, and representation and retention in structure. It also discusses co-design affinities across behaviors and their links to latency, throughput, and memory objectives.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, it does not present a unified experimental contribution. The value is in the taxonomy and decomposition of the design space rather than new benchmark gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The University of Melbourne and Huazhong University of Science and Technology. No clearly identifiable flagship LLM serving lab signal from the metadata alone.

recommendation.zh: 不是新结果，但分类框架还算干净；做长上下文或 serving 的人看 taxonomy 即可，别指望有新结论。
recommendation.en: Not a source of new results, but the taxonomy is clean enough; read it for the design map if you work on long-context serving, not for fresh conclusions.

paper.title: Multimodal Unlearning Across Vision, Language, Video, and Audio: Survey of Methods, Datasets, and Benchmarks
paper.abstract: With the growing adoption of VLMs, DMs, LLMs, and AFMs, these multimodal foundation models can inadvertently encode sensitive, copyrighted, biased, or unsafe cross-modal associations that originate from their training data. Retraining after deletion requests or policy updates is often impractical, and targeted forgetting remains difficult because knowledge is distributed across shared representations. Multimodal unlearning addresses this challenge by enabling selective removal across modalities

summary.core_problem: 系统梳理多模态 foundation models 在视觉、语言、视频和音频中的选择性遗忘问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 survey 和 taxonomy，关注删除强度、保留能力、效率、可逆性和鲁棒性之间的权衡。它不直接提出预训练方法，但对训练数据合规、版权删除和跨模态表示污染有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文按模型架构和模态组织 multimodal unlearning 方法，比较不同遗忘目标、数据集、benchmark 和评估协议；重点讨论知识在共享表示中分布式存储时，单模态删除如何影响跨模态关联。
summary.experiments: 作为综述论文，核心不是新实验；摘要未给出统一复现实验、模型规模或量化结果。主要产出是方法分类、数据集与 benchmark 汇总，以及开放问题整理。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Maryland, Baltimore County 和 University of Notre Dame。

summary_en.core_problem: The survey organizes the problem of selective forgetting in multimodal foundation models across vision, language, video, and audio.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a taxonomy of multimodal unlearning methods, datasets, and benchmarks, with attention to trade-offs among deletion strength, retention, efficiency, reversibility, and robustness. It does not advance pretraining directly, but is relevant to data compliance, copyright removal, and cross-modal representation contamination.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper categorizes unlearning approaches by architecture and modality, compares forgetting objectives, datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation protocols, and discusses how distributed shared representations make cross-modal deletion difficult.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, it does not center on new experiments. The abstract does not report unified reproduction, model scale, or quantitative gains. The main deliverables are taxonomy, resource mapping, and open-problem analysis.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of Maryland, Baltimore County and the University of Notre Dame.

recommendation.zh: 作为 unlearning 入口材料留档即可；预训练研究员重点看跨模态遗忘指标，不必逐篇跟方法细节。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an entry point for unlearning; a pretraining researcher should focus on the cross-modal forgetting metrics, not every method detail.

paper.title: Recursive Self-Improvement in AI: From Bounded Self-Refinement to Autonomous Research Loops
paper.abstract: AI systems increasingly participate in their own improvement: revising their outputs, adapting their own harnesses during deployment, training on data they generate, and, increasingly, conducting AI research itself. This literature is described under a vocabulary ("self-refine," "self-reward," "self-play," "self-evolve") that conflates fundamentally different ambitions. We survey 1,250 arXiv papers (2024-2026) along two axes: what the system improves -- its behavior in deployment, its policy thr

summary.core_problem: 梳理 AI 系统参与自身改进时，不同“self-refine / self-reward / self-play / self-evolve”概念被混用的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是高层分类与机制分析。它试图把有限自我修正、训练级自我改进、评估器自我改进、自动化研究循环分开，有助于讨论 self-improvement 时避免把可验证的工程循环和开放式 RSI 混在一起。
summary.technical_approach: 调研 2024-2026 年 1,250 篇 arXiv 论文，并按两个轴分类：系统改进的对象是什么，以及循环闭合程度从 human-in-the-loop 到 fully closed 的位置。分类中特别加入 self-evaluation，强调 evaluator 在闭环中的独立角色。
summary.experiments: 这是 survey/taxonomy，不是实验型论文。摘要称 bounded self-refinement 已经可收敛、可评估并进入工业实践；开放式 RSI 在 grounding、collapse dynamics 和 compute constraints 上仍受限制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the overloaded vocabulary around AI self-improvement, where self-refine, self-reward, self-play, and self-evolve often refer to different loop structures.
summary_en.importance: It is a taxonomy and analysis paper. The main contribution is separating bounded self-refinement from broader recursive self-improvement, which matters for evaluating claims about autonomous model improvement.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors survey 1,250 arXiv papers from 2024 to 2026 and classify them by what is being improved and how closed the loop is. The taxonomy explicitly includes self-evaluation as a separate category.
summary_en.experiments: There are no model-training experiments. The abstract argues that bounded self-refinement is convergent and already used in practice, while open-ended RSI remains constrained by grounding, collapse dynamics, and compute.

recommendation.zh: 当术语清理材料看即可；真正有用的是 taxonomy，别把它当自我改进可行性的实验证据。
recommendation.en: Use it as terminology cleanup; the taxonomy is useful, but it is not empirical evidence that open-ended self-improvement works.

paper.title: Beyond the Autoregressive Horizon: A Comprehensive Survey of Diffusion Models, World Modelling, and State Space Models for Code
paper.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) language models have driven significant progress in automated software engineering, enabling powerful code generation and assistance systems. However, the next-token prediction paradigm introduces structural limitations for code reasoning, including restricted global planning, challenges in maintaining long-range dependencies, and limited grounding in program execution semantics. Noting the heavy skewness of existing literature towards AR models, we discuss emerging paradigms

summary.core_problem: 在代码智能场景下，next-token 自回归范式的结构性限制（全局规划、长程依赖、执行语义落地）是否有替代建模路线可走。
summary.importance: 综述型工作：把“非AR代码建模”相关的三条线（Diffusion code generation / Code world models / State space models）放到同一框架下讨论，帮助预训练研究员快速定位可能挑战 AR 的范式与关键瓶颈。
summary.technical_approach: 以问题驱动方式梳理：1) 扩散模型用整体去噪生成以更好满足全局语法/结构约束；2) 代码世界模型通过显式/隐式执行状态模拟来增强语义与可验证性；3) SSM 以线性时间序列建模缓解长上下文成本。主要是概念归纳与文献组织，不提出新训练目标或新架构实现细节。
summary.experiments: 无原创实验（survey）。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether alternatives to next-token autoregressive modeling can better address structural limitations in code intelligence (global planning, long-range dependencies, and grounding in execution semantics).
summary_en.importance: A survey that consolidates three non-AR directions for code modeling—diffusion models, code world models, and state space models—useful for quickly mapping the design space that could challenge AR pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Problem-driven literature organization: (1) diffusion-style holistic denoising for global syntactic/structural constraints, (2) code world models that simulate execution states for semantic grounding and verification, and (3) SSMs for linear-time long-context modeling. No new objective/architecture is introduced.
summary_en.experiments: No original experiments (survey).

recommendation.zh: 当作“非AR代码建模路线图”备查即可；别指望有可复现的 recipe，主要价值是帮你快速列出 diffusion/CWM/SSM 三条线的关键问题清单。
recommendation.en: Use it as a map of non-AR code modeling threads; don’t expect reproducible recipes—its value is a curated problem checklist across diffusion/CWMs/SSMs.

paper.title: From Static Inference to Dynamic Interaction: A Survey of Streaming Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Standard Large Language Models (LLMs) are predominantly designed for static inference with pre-defined inputs, which limits their applicability in dynamic, real-time scenarios. To address this gap, the streaming LLM paradigm has emerged. However, existing definitions of streaming LLMs remain fragmented, conflating streaming generation, streaming inputs, and interactive streaming architectures, while a systematic taxonomy is still lacking. This paper provides a comprehensive overview and analysis

summary.core_problem: 对流式大型语言模型（Streaming LLMs）进行系统性的综述和分类，解决现有定义碎片化和概念混淆的问题。
summary.importance: 首次基于数据流和动态交互为流式 LLM 建立了统一的定义，并提出了系统的分类法，有助于理清该领域的研究脉络。
summary.technical_approach: 基于数据流和动态交互建立统一的流式 LLM 定义；提出系统的分类法；深入讨论底层方法论；探讨实际应用场景并展望未来研究方向。
summary.experiments: 本文为综述文章，无具体实验。

summary_en.core_problem: Providing a systematic survey and taxonomy of streaming Large Language Models (LLMs) to address the fragmentation and conceptual confusion in existing definitions.
summary_en.importance: Establishes a unified definition of streaming LLMs based on data flow and dynamic interaction for the first time, and proposes a systematic taxonomy, helping to clarify the research landscape in this field.
summary_en.technical_approach: Establishes a unified definition of streaming LLMs based on data flow and dynamic interaction; proposes a systematic taxonomy; discusses underlying methodologies in depth; explores real-world applications and outlines future research directions.
summary_en.experiments: This is a survey paper, no specific experiments.

recommendation.zh: 关于流式 LLM 的综述文章，理清了相关概念，作为 literature 备查，不读正文。
recommendation.en: A survey on streaming LLMs that clarifies related concepts. Keep as a literature reference, no need to read the full text.

paper.title: A First-Principles Derivation of LLM Policy Optimization: From Expected Reward to GRPO and Its Structural Extensions
paper.abstract: Policy gradient algorithms for language models optimize the same objective $J(θ) = \mathbb{E}*{τ\sim p*θ(τ)}[R(τ)]$, which has exactly two factors: the trajectory probability $p_θ(τ)$ and the reward $R(τ)$. Every method from REINFORCE to PPO to GRPO and their descendants modifies one or both factors to address a specific failure in the preceding formulation. Existing surveys organize these methods by domain or chronology, which obscures the rationale behind each design choice and the precise loc

summary.core_problem: 如何从第一性原理出发，统一理解和分类从 REINFORCE 到 GRPO 及其变体的 LLM 策略优化算法？
summary.importance: 提供了一个统一的、诊断性的、可扩展的框架，通过轨迹概率和奖励两个维度，清晰地解析了各种 RLHF/RLAIF 算法的设计动机和梯度估计器的具体干预点，有助于深入理解后训练算法的演进。
summary.technical_approach: 从策略梯度的基本目标函数 $J(\theta) = \mathbb{E}_{\tau\sim p_\theta(\tau)}[R(\tau)]$ 出发，将其分解为轨迹概率 $p_\theta(\tau)$ 和奖励 $R(\tau)$ 两个因子。将现有的策略优化方法（REINFORCE, PPO, GRPO, Agentic RL 等）映射到这两个维度上，分析它们是为了解决前序方法的哪些具体失效模式而对这两个因子进行的修改。
summary.experiments: 本文为理论推导和综述，无具体模型训练实验，但系统梳理了各算法的数学形式和演进逻辑。

summary_en.core_problem: How to uniformly understand and categorize LLM policy optimization algorithms from REINFORCE to GRPO and its variants from first principles?
summary_en.importance: Provides a unified, diagnostic, and extensible framework that clearly analyzes the design motivations and specific intervention points in the gradient estimator of various RLHF/RLAIF algorithms through the dimensions of trajectory probability and reward, facilitating a deep understanding of post-training algorithm evolution.
summary_en.technical_approach: Starting from the fundamental policy gradient objective $J(\theta) = \mathbb{E}_{\tau\sim p_\theta(\tau)}[R(\tau)]$, it decomposes it into two factors: trajectory probability $p_\theta(\tau)$ and reward $R(\tau)$. It maps existing policy optimization methods (REINFORCE, PPO, GRPO, Agentic RL, etc.) onto these two dimensions, analyzing how they modify these factors to address specific failure modes of preceding methods.
summary_en.experiments: This is a theoretical derivation and survey paper; no specific model training experiments, but it systematically reviews the mathematical forms and evolutionary logic of various algorithms.

recommendation.zh: 极好的 RLHF/GRPO 算法推导综述，从第一性原理拆解了 reward 和 trajectory 两个维度的演进，强烈建议 post-train 和 pretrain 接口研究员阅读。
recommendation.en: An excellent derivation survey of RLHF/GRPO algorithms, breaking down the evolution along reward and trajectory dimensions from first principles; highly recommended for post-train and pretrain interface researchers.

paper.title: Beyond NL2Code: A Structured Survey of Multimodal Code Intelligence
paper.abstract: While LLMs have substantially advanced text-to-code synthesis, many real programming tasks specify intent through visual artifacts such as screenshots, charts, documents, vector drawings, videos, and interactive states. These tasks require models to connect visual perception to executable programs, because correctness depends not only on syntax but also on layout, geometry, data semantics, editability, interaction behavior, and domain-specific constraints that apply after execution. This survey

summary.core_problem: 现有代码生成研究主要关注文本到代码(NL2Code)，但许多真实编程任务通过视觉产物(截图/图表/视频/交互状态)表达意图，需要连接视觉感知与可执行代码。
summary.importance: 首次系统梳理多模态代码智能领域的结构化综述，贡献了新的分类框架。
summary.technical_approach: 按代码在任务中的角色将多模态代码智能分为五类：渲染产物/可编辑符号结构/科学表示/中间推理轨迹/可执行策略或工具接口；按四个应用领域(GUI/科学可视化/游戏与创意工具/机器人与自动化)组织benchmark和方法。
summary.experiments: 综述性论文，无独立实验。
summary.authors_note: 香港大学/香港中文大学/南京大学/哈工大/阿德莱德大学等机构合作。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing code generation research focuses on NL2Code, but many real programming tasks express intent through visual artifacts (screenshots, charts, videos, interactive states), requiring models to connect visual perception with executable code.
summary_en.importance: First structured survey of multimodal code intelligence, contributing a novel classification framework.
summary_en.technical_approach: Categorizes multimodal code intelligence into five roles: rendered artifact / editable symbolic structure / scientific representation / intermediate reasoning trace / executable policy or tool interface; organizes benchmarks and methods across four application domains: GUI, scientific visualization, games & creative tools, robotics & automation.
summary_en.experiments: Survey paper, no independent experiments.
summary_en.authors_note: Collaboration across The University of Hong Kong, CUHK, Nanjing University, HIT, University of Adelaide, etc.

recommendation.zh: 多模态代码智能的结构化综述，作为literature备查即可，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Structured survey of multimodal code intelligence; useful as literature reference but no need to read the full text.

paper.title: Agentic Environment Engineering for Large Language Models: A Survey of Environment Modeling, Synthesis, Evaluation, and Application
paper.abstract: Environments serve as interactive systems for large language model (LLM) based agents across diverse scenarios and play a crucial role in driving the continual evolution of model capabilities. Despite this importance, existing work lacks a systematic categorization and deep analysis. This paper systematically studies current researches on agentic environments from the perspective of the environment engineering lifecycle, covering their modeling, synthesis, evaluation and application. Specificall

summary.core_problem: 系统梳理LLM Agent中环境工程的研究现状，从环境建模、合成、评估和应用四个维度进行分类和分析。
summary.importance: 综述性贡献：首次从环境工程生命周期角度对Agent环境进行系统化研究，提出了8属性8领域的分类框架。
summary.technical_approach: 从8个属性（可观察性、确定性、动作空间等）和8个应用领域分析代表性环境；将环境自动合成分为符号合成和神经合成两类；讨论不同范式下的环境评估方法。

summary_en.core_problem: Systematically surveys research on agentic environments for LLMs from the perspective of the environment engineering lifecycle: modeling, synthesis, evaluation, and application.
summary_en.importance: Survey contribution: first systematic study of agent environments organized by lifecycle stages, proposing an 8-attribute × 8-domain classification framework.
summary_en.technical_approach: Analyzes representative environments across 8 attributes (observability, determinism, action space, etc.) and 8 application domains; categorizes automated environment synthesis into symbolic and neural paradigms; discusses evaluation methods for each paradigm.

summary_en.authors_note: Key Lab of Cognition and Decision Intelligence for Complex Systems, CAS. Authors include Kang Liu and Jun Zhao.

recommendation.zh: Agent环境工程的综述，覆盖面广但非预训练核心方向，作为领域背景备查即可，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Survey on agent environment engineering with broad coverage but not core to pretraining; useful as literature reference, no need to read the main text.

paper.title: Toward Secure LLM Agents: Threat Surfaces, Attacks, Defenses, and Evaluation
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are rapidly moving from conversational interfaces to software components that plan, invoke tools, maintain memory, and act on external environments. This transition changes the nature of security risk. In agentic settings, failures are no longer limited to unsafe text generation. Untrusted content may redirect control flow, misuse tool privileges, corrupt persistent state, leak sensitive information, or trigger harmful external actions. At the same time, researc

summary.core_problem: LLM Agent 从对话接口演进为具备规划、工具调用、持久记忆和环境交互能力的软件组件后，安全风险性质发生根本性变化——失败不再局限于不安全文本生成，还可能表现为流程劫持、未授权工具使用、状态损坏、数据泄露或有害外部操作。但当前 LLM Agent 安全研究在攻击类型、防御层次、应用领域和评测设置上高度碎片化，缺乏统一的系统级分析框架。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要集中在两个层面：(1) Agent 安全被定位为系统安全问题而非单纯 prompt 级模型安全问题，这对 pretrain→posttrain 闭环中如何考虑 Agent 场景的安全目标有参考意义；(2) 综述识别出的研究空白（持久状态完整性、工具介导的权限滥用、多 Agent 传播、长程有状态风险评测不足）提示了未来预训练与 Agent 安全结合的方向。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了 247 篇论文的精选语料库，采用基于生命周期的系统导向分析框架，围绕输入、规划、决策、工具执行、输出、记忆、监控和协同的 Agent 循环建模安全风险的产生与传播。该框架将 prompt 注入、内存破坏、工具滥用和多 Agent 风险统一在同一框架下进行结构化比较，并按防御介入位置和假设进行分类。
summary.experiments: 这是综述论文，无原创实验。语料统计分析显示该领域从 2023 年 3 篇快速增长至 2024 年 42 篇、2025 年 121 篇，截至 2026 年 4 月共 81 篇，反映领域发展迅速但术语、方法论规范和部署假设仍未稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看框架设计章节和研究空白分析部分，快速扫读攻击分类和防御综述以把握领域全貌。预计阅读时间：20-30 分钟（速读核心框架和结论）。

summary_en.core_problem: As LLM agents evolve from conversational interfaces to software components with planning, tool invocation, persistent memory, and environmental interaction capabilities, the nature of security risk fundamentally changes — failures are no longer limited to unsafe text generation but can manifest as hijacked workflows, unauthorized tool use, state corruption, data leakage, or harmful external actions. However, current LLM agent security research remains highly fragmented across attack types, defense layers, application domains, and evaluation settings, lacking a unified system-level analytical framework.
summary_en.importance: The primary relevance to pretraining research is twofold: (1) agent security is framed as a systems security problem rather than purely prompt-level model safety, which informs how safety objectives for agentic scenarios should be considered in the pretrain-to-posttrain loop; (2) identified research gaps (persistent state integrity, tool-mediated privilege misuse, multi-agent propagation, insufficient long-horizon stateful evaluation) suggest future directions at the intersection of pretraining and agent security.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a curated corpus of 247 papers and applies a lifecycle-based, systems-oriented analytical framework that models how security risks emerge and propagate across the agentic loop (inputs, planning, decisions, tool execution, outputs, memory, monitoring, coordination). This unifies prompt injection, memory corruption, tool abuse, and multi-agent risk within a single framework for structured comparison of defenses and evaluations by intervention point and assumptions.
summary_en.experiments: This is a survey paper with no original experiments. Corpus statistics show rapid growth: 3 papers in 2023, 42 in 2024, 121 in 2025, and 81 collected by April 2026, indicating rapid field evolution with unsettled terminology, methodological norms, and deployment assumptions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the framework design and research gaps sections. Skim attack taxonomy and defense survey for landscape awareness. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes for core framework and conclusions.

recommendation.zh: agent 安全的系统综述，方法无创新但框架清晰；做 agent/tool-use 对齐或安全评测时可作文献地图，不必深读正文。
recommendation.en: A systems-oriented survey of LLM agent security with no methodological novelty but a clean taxonomy; useful as a literature map when working on agent alignment or safety evaluation.

paper.title: Test-Time Scaling in Multimodal Foundation Models: A Comprehensive Survey of Generation and Reasoning
paper.abstract: Test-time Scaling (TTS) has emerged as a pivotal research direction for enhancing model performance by dynamically allocating computational resources during inference. Recent advancements have adapted this paradigm to Multimodal Foundation Models (MFMs), unlocking their potential in multimodal reasoning and generation. Despite rapid progress, the field lacks a systematic survey and unified theoretical framework to delineate the developmental landscape of multimodal TTS. To bridge this gap, we pr

summary.core_problem: 梳理多模态基础模型中的 test-time scaling 方法，回答推理时如何动态分配额外计算以提升生成与推理能力。
summary.importance: 这是综述而非新方法，但主题与当前 inference-time compute、search、feedback、sampling 的研究主线直接相关；对预训练研究员的价值在于建立问题地图，而不是提供新证据。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一个统一分类框架，将多模态 TTS 方法分为 sampling-based、feedback-based、search-based 三类，并整理其在多模态生成与推理中的应用场景、常用 benchmark 以及开放问题。
summary.experiments: 作为 survey，不提供新的模型规模、训练数据或基准突破；实验部分主要是对已有工作和评测资产的归纳，而非原创实证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper surveys test-time scaling in multimodal foundation models, asking how extra inference compute can be allocated to improve generation and reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is a survey rather than a new method, but the topic is directly tied to current work on inference-time compute, search, feedback, and sampling. Its value to pretraining researchers is in organizing the space, not in providing new evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes a unified taxonomy that groups multimodal TTS methods into sampling-based, feedback-based, and search-based approaches, and reviews their applications, benchmarks, and open challenges in multimodal generation and reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, it does not introduce new model scales, training data, or benchmark gains. The empirical content is a synthesis of prior methods and evaluation assets rather than original experimentation.

recommendation.zh: 综述价值大于研究价值；如果你在想 pretrain 与 inference-time compute 的接口，只看 taxonomy 和 benchmark 表即可，不必通读。
recommendation.en: More useful as a map than as research; if you're thinking about the pretrain ↔ inference-time compute interface, the taxonomy and benchmark tables are enough.

paper.title: Bridging the Agent-World Gap: Text World Models for LLM-based Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly used in interactive textual environments, from web navigation and code editing to tool use and long-horizon dialogue. Yet many remain largely reactive, mapping observations to actions without an explicit model of how these environments are structured and evolve. This motivates text world models (TWMs): transition models over textual states that, given a state and a candidate action, predict the resulting webpage, terminal output, API respo

summary.core_problem: LLM Agent 在文本交互环境中大多是反应式的，缺乏对环境结构和演化的显式建模，无法支持规划、高效学习和原则性评估。
summary.importance: 首次系统提出文本世界模型（TWM）的形式化框架，将其作为连接 Agent 与环境的桥梁，属于综述与框架性贡献。
summary.technical_approach: 围绕形式化框架和 Agent 生命周期组织：（1）基础：定义 TWM 并按状态表示和领域分类；（2）构建：LLM-as-WM 和 Code-as-WM 两种范式；（3）应用：如何支持规划、学习和评估。
summary.experiments: 无独立实验，是系统性综述。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM-based agents in interactive textual environments remain largely reactive, lacking explicit models of how environments are structured and evolve, hindering planning, efficient learning, and principled evaluation.
summary_en.importance: First systematic formalization of Text World Models (TWM) as a bridge between agents and environments; a framework and survey contribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: Organized around a formal framework and the agent lifecycle: (1) Foundations — define TWM, characterize by state representation and grounding domain; (2) Construction — taxonomize LLM-as-WM and Code-as-WM paradigms; (3) Application — support planning, learning, and evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: No original experiments; a systematic survey.

recommendation.zh: 作为 Agent 世界模型方向的文献地图备查，不读正文；目前该方向尚未形成对 pretrain 的反哺信号。
recommendation.en: Use as a literature map for agent world models; skip the full text — the direction hasn't yet produced actionable signals for pretraining.

paper.title: Are Large Language Models Suitable for Graph Computation? Progress and Prospects
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly explored for graph computation, where tasks require reasoning over structured relationships and algorithmic operations. Yet, it remains unclear when LLMs can reliably support such computation and how they should be incorporated into graph-solving pipelines. Existing surveys at the intersection of LLMs and graphs primarily focus on graph learning, text-attributed graphs, or graph-language modeling. To bridge this gap, we provide a comprehensive

summary.core_problem: 综述 LLM 是否适合图计算任务，以及应当直接执行图算法，还是作为规划器调用外部工具完成图求解。

summary_en.importance: The contribution is a taxonomy and literature review rather than a new model or training method. For base-model researchers, it is mainly useful as background on the limits of structured and algorithmic reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a role-based taxonomy with two paradigms: LLMs as executors, directly solving graph tasks from descriptions and instructions; and LLMs as planners, formulating problems, decomposing steps, and invoking external tools or agents for execution. paper.title: Beyond tokens: a unified framework for latent communication in LLM-based multi-agent systems
paper.abstract: Multi-agent systems built on large language models (LLMs) have become a prevailing paradigm for tackling complex reasoning, planning, and tool-use tasks. The dominant communication protocol in such systems is natural language: agents exchange messages token-by-token, verbalising their internal reasoning so that peers can read, verify, and respond. While convenient and interpretable, this protocol suffers from three structural drawbacks -- high inference cost, irreversible information loss during

summary.core_problem: 整理并统一 LLM 多智能体系统中的 latent communication 研究，回答 agent 之间除了自然语言外还能交换什么、怎么交换、如何训练与评估。
summary.importance: 这是综述/框架化文章，不是新方法。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于把 hidden states、embeddings、KV-cache 作为通信介质这一支文献梳理清楚，便于判断哪些设定可能反哺统一建模或 test-time compute 设计。
summary.technical_approach: 文章沿三个正交维度组织现有工作：通信内容（WHAT）、通信时机/对象（WHEN/WHO）、以及训练与优化方式（HOW）。核心不是提出算法，而是给 latent communication 建一个统一坐标系，比较文本通信与连续表示通信在成本、信息保真和可解释性上的取舍。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看没有新的系统实验或 benchmark，重点是文献归纳与概念框架。若正文包含案例表格或 taxonomy 图，适合作为快速索引，但不应当作实证结论来源。

summary_en.core_problem: It organizes the literature on latent communication in LLM-based multi-agent systems, asking what agents can exchange beyond natural language, when they exchange it, and how it is trained and evaluated.
summary_en.importance: This is a survey/framework paper rather than a new method. Its value for a pretraining researcher is mainly in clarifying the design space around hidden states, embeddings, and KV-cache as communication media, which may inform unified modeling or test-time compute design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper structures existing work along three orthogonal axes: WHAT is communicated, WHEN/WHO communicates, and HOW the communication is optimized. The contribution is a unified taxonomy rather than a new algorithm, contrasting text-based communication with continuous-representation exchange in terms of cost, information fidelity, and interpretability.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not indicate new system experiments or a benchmark; the main output is conceptual organization. If the full paper includes good taxonomy figures or comparison tables, it is useful as an index, not as primary empirical evidence.

recommendation.zh: 这是文献地图，不是结果论文；如果你在想 hidden state/KV 能否替代 token 通信，扫 taxonomy 和 related work 就够，不必细读。
recommendation.en: This is a literature map, not a results paper; if you are thinking about hidden-state/KV communication as a substitute for token exchange, skim the taxonomy and related-work tables and stop there.

paper.title: From Human Videos to Robot Manipulation: A Survey on Scalable Vision-Language-Action Learning with Human-Centric Data

Yet, embodiment differences and the frequent absence of task-alig

summary.core_problem: 如何把海量人类视频转化为可用于 Vision-Language-Action（VLA）模型的训练信号，以减少对昂贵机器人示教数据的依赖。
summary.importance: 综述型贡献：系统梳理“人类视频→动作/控制知识”的几条技术路线；对做多模态统一预训练/视频表征学习的人有参考，但不是新的预训练范式或关键实证结论。
summary.technical_approach: 按从人类视频中提取的动作相关信息将方法分四类：潜在动作表征（帧间变化编码）、预测式世界模型（预测未来帧）、显式 2D 监督（图像平面线索）、显式 3D 重建（几何/姿态等）；讨论 embodiment gap 与缺少任务标注带来的挑战。
summary.experiments: 综述论文通常不提供统一可复现的大规模对比实验；摘要未给出新的 benchmark 或统一评测协议。
summary.authors_note: Tsinghua University, Xi’an Jiaotong University, Fudan University, Microsoft Research Asia, Peking University

summary_en.core_problem: How to convert abundant human videos into effective training signals for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, reducing reliance on costly robot demonstrations.
summary_en.importance: Survey contribution: organizes the design space of extracting action/control knowledge from human videos; useful background for multimodal pretraining and video representation, but not a new pretraining paradigm or a decisive empirical result.
summary_en.technical_approach: Categorizes approaches into four groups by the action-related information derived: latent action representations, predictive world models, explicit 2D supervision, and explicit 3D reconstruction; discusses embodiment gaps and missing task-aligned annotations.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, it likely lacks a unified large-scale head-to-head experimental protocol; the abstract does not indicate a new benchmark or standardized evaluation suite.
summary_en.authors_note: Tsinghua University, Xi’an Jiaotong University, Fudan University, Microsoft Research Asia, Peking University

recommendation.zh: 当索引读：把“人类视频怎么变成动作监督”分门别类讲清楚；别指望有干净对比或可直接迁移到 LM 预训练的 recipe。
recommendation.en: Use it as an index: it cleanly maps how human videos become action supervision; don’t expect clean ablations or a recipe you can directly port to LM pretraining.

paper.title: Implicit Identity Technologies for LLMs: Fingerprinting and Watermarking across Datasets, Models, and Generated Content
